posts.body_html:
Here's a population of flavas that has been in the collection for a while yet it hasn't been documented until now! Sorry guys! But hey, undocumented flavas ain't that big of a deal, right?! Well, we prolly shouldn't get so political in this forum, I'll leave it at that!

This is the same population that has the giant maximas that can get very yellow! I still haven't been able to get good shots of them, but I will in the future! In the meantime, check out these yellowful plants, pics taken mostly late June 2022. S. flava var. flava Horry Co, SC:
